articles.title: Situational Awareness hedge fund meltdown was a warning shot for leveraged markets, BofA CEO says

articles.title: Disney weighs free, ad-supported streaming, says it has sold out Super Bowl ad spots
articles.description: Disney is considering a free streaming product as advertising takes a bigger role in making streaming profitable.

articles.title: Eliza Founder Declares AI Token 'Dead,' Shuts Down Foundation After Lawsuit Settlement
articles.description: Shaw Walters says Eliza's token is no more after a class-action settlement drained the project's remaining funds.

articles.title: SpaceX dives 9% after AI spending surge rattles investors
articles.description: CEO Elon Musk said SpaceX would hit $1 trillion in annual revenue in 2030 versus a previous forecast of 2031 as he looked to strike an bullish tone.

articles.title: Private companies added just 44,000 workers in July, below expectations, ADP reports
articles.description: Hiring at private companies slowed considerably in July, with most of the job growth coming health care.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Putting the bitcoin sizing question to the test
articles.description: In a follow-up to his essay on sizing crypto risk, Lionsoul Global's Gregory Mall backtests bitcoin in a 60/40 across bull, bear and sideways regimes, showing how a straight bitcoin position, a large-cap basket and a trend-managed sleeve part ways and why the way you hold bitcoin can matter as much as how much you hold.

articles.title: Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Democratic Senate primary as voters pivot to the left
articles.description: Abdul El-Sayed won the Michigan Democratic Senate primary, setting up a context with former Rep. Mike Rogers in the November general election.

articles.title: Gold hits six-week highs on China demand as Bitcoin ignores fresh S&P 500 record
articles.description: Gold and US stocks stole the limelight on Wednesday as Bitcoin failed to gain significantly beyond $64,000.

articles.title: Amazon's Zoox to launch paid robotaxi service in Las Vegas on Aug. 10
articles.description: It's the company's first commercial market after Zoox started offering free rides to the public in parts of Las Vegas and San Francisco less than a year ago.

articles.title: Bank of America spends $250 million a year on GLP-1 drugs for its employees, CEO says
articles.description: Employers have grappled with soaring demand for GLP-1 drugs such as Ozempic and Wegovy, which can cost thousands of dollars per patient annually.

articles.title: Trump admin refunds $100 billion in 'liberation day' tariffs

articles.title: Strategy’s STRC rebounds 30% as company builds cash reserve, bitcoin price stabilizes
articles.description: Bitcoin sales, what is now a $4 billion cash reserve, and a $975 million repurchase program, have supported STRC’s recovery.

articles.description: The company didn't provide updated guidance. New CEO Silvio Napoli earlier this year suspended production expectations.

articles.description: Bitcoin, Ethereum and XRP whales increased balances during market weakness, as CryptoQuant said large holders are absorbing supply ahead of a possible bottom.

articles.title: AMD sinks 5% despite earnings beat, strong data center revenue
